duration.recordedNote: Recorded time is for information only; it is not an approved working time.

meeting.title: Meeting report
meeting.intro: Filled in after each meeting, for that mentee. Once sent, it is added to your daily report and weekly summary.

MEETING.title: Meeting details
MEETING.hint: Filled in from the calendar; correct it if needed.

TOPIC.title: Topic and purpose
TOPIC.hint: What the mentee brought to this meeting

DETAILS.title: What you discussed
DETAILS.hint: What did you talk about, and how did it go?

SKILLS.title: Skills you used
SKILLS.hint: Which skills did you use as a mentor in this meeting?

OUTCOMES.title: Outcomes and next steps
OUTCOMES.hint: The meeting's concrete result and who does what

EVALUATION.title: Evaluation
EVALUATION.hint: Your own observation; the mentee does not see it.

meeting.sectionMissing: This section has required fields left empty.
meeting.topicsLabel: Meeting topic (pick as many as fit)
meeting.menteeNeed: What did the mentee need? Which question or problem did they bring?
meeting.discussion: What did you talk about? Walk through it step by step.
meeting.approach: Which method or approach did you use, and why?
meeting.skillExample: Give an example of how you used one skill
meeting.outcome: What came out of the meeting?
meeting.followUpHint: Added to the calendar as a suggestion; the mentee confirms.
meeting.nextTime: What would you do differently next time?
meeting.support: Is there something the coordinator should help with?
meeting.supportHint: If you choose "Yes", the coordinator contacts you separately; you don't need to write the details here.
meeting.privacy: Do not write sensitive details such as the mentee's health, family or finances. The coordinator sees the report.
meeting.tip: Fill in the report right after the meeting, the same day at the latest. Be concrete: "we rewrote the project section of the CV together" rather than "I helped".
meeting.sentNote: Sent · {time}. The report is locked; you can still tick off action steps.
meeting.saveFailed: The report could not be saved.
meeting.sendFailed: The report could not be sent.
meeting.notFound: This meeting's report could not be found.
meeting.missingSummary: The report was not sent. Sections with required fields left empty: {sections}
